    SELECT

    FROM (
        SELECT r.milliseconds
        FROM results r

          AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
          AND r.positionorder = 1

        SELECT

        FROM results last
        JOIN races ra ON last.raceid = ra.raceid
        JOIN results champion ON champion.raceid = last.raceid AND champion.positionorder = 1
        WHERE ra.year = 2008
          AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
          AND last.positionorder = (
              SELECT MAX(positionorder)
              FROM results r2
              WHERE r2.raceid = last.raceid
                AND r2.time IS NOT NULL
          )
          AND last.time IS NOT NULL
